description: This PHP source file defines the MyDocumentsDashlet class, a custom dashlet component for the SuiteCRM platform. It extends the DashletGeneric class, manages display options, and loads configuration data for the dashlet associated with documents.

classes.name: MyDocumentsDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for displaying user documents, extending the generic dashlet functionality with specific configuration and display options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dashlet with configuration data, setting title, search fields, columns, and seed bean.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays and processes the dashlet's display options, including loading a Document object and rendering the search fields with external API types.
